description:
Class representing a presentation visitor. It walks slides, layouts, masters, speaker notes, drawings (including
the drawings nested in groups, table cells and chart titles) and the paragraphs and runs of their text.
Assign functions to the hooks to be notified; return true from a hook to skip the subtree of that node.

Drawing.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a drawing (a shape, an image, a chart, a group, a table...).
Drawing.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the content of the drawing; the DrawingEnd hook is not called then.

DrawingEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a drawing (a shape, an image, a chart, a group, a table...).
DrawingEnd.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Layout.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a slide layout.
Layout.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the content of the slide layout; the LayoutEnd hook is not called then.

LayoutEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a slide layout.
LayoutEnd.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Master.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the content of the slide master; the MasterEnd hook is not called then.

MasterEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a slide master.
MasterEnd.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Notes.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the content of the speaker notes page; the NotesEnd hook is not called then.

NotesEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a speaker notes page.

Paragraph.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a paragraph. Assign a function to it to process paragraphs.

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected paragraph, the index of the first selected element of the paragraph (a run, a hyperlink, an inline content control...); undefined when the whole paragraph is traversed.
params.name: start

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected paragraph, the index of the last selected element of the paragraph, inclusive; undefined when the whole paragraph is traversed.
params.name: end

Paragraph.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the content of the paragraph; the ParagraphEnd hook is not called then.

Paragraph.signature: Paragraph(paragraph: ApiParagraph, start?: number, end?: number): boolean

ParagraphEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a paragraph.

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected paragraph, the index of the first selected element of the paragraph (a run, a hyperlink, an inline content control...); undefined when the whole paragraph is traversed.
params.name: start

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected paragraph, the index of the last selected element of the paragraph, inclusive; undefined when the whole paragraph is traversed.
params.name: end

ParagraphEnd.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
ParagraphEnd.signature: ParagraphEnd(paragraph: ApiParagraph, start?: number, end?: number): boolean

Run.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a text run. A run that contains only the paragraph mark is skipped.

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected run, the position of the first selected run element (a character, a space, a tab, a line break, a drawing...); undefined when the whole run is traversed.
params.name: start

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected run, the position after the last selected run element, exclusive; undefined when the whole run is traversed.
params.name: end

Run.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the text of the run; the Text and RunEnd hooks are not called for it then.

Run.signature: Run(run: ApiRun, start?: number, end?: number): boolean

RunEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a text run.

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected run, the position of the first selected run element (a character, a space, a tab, a line break, a drawing...); undefined when the whole run is traversed.
params.name: start

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected run, the position after the last selected run element, exclusive; undefined when the whole run is traversed.
params.name: end

RunEnd.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
RunEnd.signature: RunEnd(run: ApiRun, start?: number, end?: number): boolean

Slide.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Stop.description: Stops the traversal. No further hooks are called after the current one returns.
Stop.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Table.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a table. It is called after the Drawing hook for the same table.
Table.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the rows of the table; the TableEnd hook is not called then.

TableCell.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a table cell.

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected cell, the index of the first selected element of the cell content (a paragraph, a table, a block content control); undefined when the whole cell is traversed.
params.name: start

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected cell, the index of the last selected element of the cell content, inclusive; undefined when the whole cell is traversed.
params.name: end

TableCell.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the content of the cell; the TableCellEnd hook is not called then.

TableCell.signature: TableCell(cell: ApiTableCell, start?: number, end?: number): boolean

TableCellEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a table cell.

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected cell, the index of the first selected element of the cell content (a paragraph, a table, a block content control); undefined when the whole cell is traversed.
params.name: start

params.description: With a selection traversal of a partly selected cell, the index of the last selected element of the cell content, inclusive; undefined when the whole cell is traversed.
params.name: end

TableCellEnd.signature: TableCellEnd(cell: ApiTableCell, start?: number, end?: number): boolean

TableEnd.description: A hook called when the traversal leaves a table.
TableEnd.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

TableRow.description: A hook called when the traversal enters a table row.
TableRow.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

returns.description: Return true to skip the cells of the row; the TableRowEnd hook is not called then.

Text.description: A hook called with the text of a run. Letters, spaces, tabs ("\t") and line breaks ("\n") that follow one another come as one string; any other run element splits the text into separate calls.
Text.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

Traverse.description: Traverses the object the visitor was created from and calls the assigned hooks for every node.

params.description: Traversal options. Passing true is the same as {selection: true}.
params.name: options
params.type: { selection?: boolean; notes?: boolean; masters?: boolean; layouts?: boolean } | boolean

Traverse.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
Traverse.signature: Traverse(options?: { selection?: boolean; notes?: boolean; masters?: boolean; layouts?: boolean } | boolean): boolean
